_comment: Google Drive anchors for the price monitor. The quick-entry sheet is the human entry surface (native Google Sheet, created 2026-07-17); the weekly job reads it via the Drive connector and merges rows into data/price-log.csv. Reports are published as new text-based files into the reports folder (Drive connector cannot edit files in place or upload binaries reliably — see ARCHITECTURE.md D2 publishing mechanics).
